content: प्रकट {%a.%} .²1 Evident, plain, clear, apparent, manifest. .²2 Undisguised, public; अप्रकटीकृतशक्तिः शक्तोऽपि जनस्तिरस्क्रियां लभते <ls>Pt. 1. 31</ls>. .²3 Visible. .{@-टम्@} {%ind.%} .²1 Clearly, manifestly, evidently. .²2 Publicly, openly, undisguisedly. (प्रकटीकृ to manifest, unfold, display; गुह्यं च गूहति गुणान् प्रकटीकरोति <ls>Bh. 2. 72</ls>; <ls>Pt. 1. 31</ls>; प्रकटीभू ‘to become manifest, appear’).
